_anonymised_copy: Anonymised copy of a registered protocol file: internal provenance fields (storage ids, hosts, resource accounting, internal review notes) were removed or redacted. Embedded sha256 values refer to the original registered file and do not match this copy.
name: output_analyses_plan
track: research track 2026-11, output analyses (plan steps 'Tabulate absolute rewrite accuracy', 'Compute coverage-conditioned outcomes')
project: PAKDD 2027 research track paper 'Data-Efficient TKGQA via Structural Guidance and Symbolic Execution' (MultiTQ)
status: DESCRIPTIVE / POST HOC. Analyses of already-frozen, already-scored outputs only: no new arm, no new model inference, no new test predictions, no GPU. Nothing here changes or re-labels any registered result (k% rule [id], amendments [id] / [id], R1 audit protocol [id], R2 rule [id] + A1 [id] + A2 [id]). No decision criterion is attached; no PASS/FAIL label is produced. Every test-split number is labelled as reuse of the official MultiTQ test split (n = 54,584) or of the R1/R2 perturbed subsets drawn from it.
registered_before: any number of analysis A1 (other than the existing audit results being reproduced) and any number of analysis A2 was computed. Already read before registration: the existing audit results [id] / [id], the scorers, file structures (field names, one bundle row), and the sha256 of the three test bundle files.

A1_absolute_rewrite_accuracy.arms_levels: S_k (Ranker; Hits@1 averaged over the 3 ranker-seed files), G_k (Reader, LoRA seed 0), P_k (Parser; averaged over the 3 ranker-seed files), RULE_k (deterministic Rules list, variants_RULE.jsonl) at k = 1, 5, 100 (k01_s0, k05_s0, k100); GU_k (Dense-RAG) at k = 1, 100 only (no GU_5 variant predictions exist in R1 or R2; GU_5 is not run here).
A1_absolute_rewrite_accuracy.variants: ORIGINAL = synthetic quid 10*quid + 0; REWRITE = 10*quid + 3 (R1 paraphrase P3, R2 rewrite RW).
A1_absolute_rewrite_accuracy.statistics: Per arm and population: original Hits@1, rewrite Hits@1, drop = original - rewrite. 95% CIs by paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over questions, B = 2,000, seed 0, percentile; one weight matrix per population (B x n, drawn row by row with numpy default_rng(0).poisson(1, n), the same stream as audit_score_R1.boot and score_R2.summarise(., 2000, 0)), shared by original, rewrite, drop and all arms, so all quantities are paired. Descriptive paired arm contrasts on rewrite Hits@1 and on drop: P_k - G_k, P_k - S_k, G_k - S_k, P_k - RULE_k at k = 1, 5, 100; P_k - GU_k and G_k - GU_k at k = 1, 100 (two-sided percentile CIs, no multiplicity correction, not decision-relevant).

populations.ALL: all judge-accepted rewrites (= every quid of the gold file: R1 569, R2 570)
populations.HUMAN_FILTERED: ALL minus the human-rejected rows (reviewed rows with not (same_answer_set == Y and same_constraint_time == Y)); unreviewed rows stay in (the audit protocols' BOUND population)
populations.RANDOM100: the simple random 100 of each probe alone (in_random100 == True), all 100 rows regardless of human verdict: an unbiased sample of the judge-accepted rewrites (descriptive)
populations.RANDOM100_ACCEPTED: RANDOM100 rows the human accepted (descriptive; unbiased for human-valid judge-accepted rewrites)

A1_absolute_rewrite_accuracy.reproduction_check: Re-run audit_score_R1.py and audit_score_R2.py (with score_R2.py) unchanged on the frozen inputs; their JSON outputs must equal [id] / [id] exactly (parsed-JSON equality). In addition, this track's drop estimates and CIs on HUMAN_FILTERED (B = 2000, seed 0) must equal the drops_after_removal entries of both files to floating-point identity. Any mismatch is reported and the tables are labelled provisional.

A2_coverage_conditioned_outcomes.population: official MultiTQ test split, n = 54,584 (reuse of the official test split; outcomes already scored and frozen)
A2_coverage_conditioned_outcomes.levels: k = 1, 5, 100 (k01_s0, k05_s0, k100). Reader G_k (seed 0), Parser P_k (mean over the 3 ranker seeds and per seed), Dense-RAG GU_k at k = 1 and 100 (GU_5 does not exist as a frozen arm). Reference rows: Ranker S_k (3-seed mean) and RULE_k on the same partitions.
A2_coverage_conditioned_outcomes.outcome: Hits@1 per question taken from the frozen per-question hits [id] (columns G_k@1, P_k_seed{0,1,2}@1, GU_k@1, S_k_seed{0,1,2}@1, RULE_k@1). As a check, G_k@1, GU_k@1 and P_k_seed*@1 are recomputed from the frozen prediction files with multitq_eval.hit_at_k and must agree on every question.
A2_coverage_conditioned_outcomes.displayed_bundle: the frozen structural guidance bundle of level k (multitq_kpct_structural_bundles.tar [id]; decompressed sha256 must equal the guided-freeze bundle_inputs sha256: k01_s0 c9f18dc2..., k05_s0 6d45bb51..., k100 01b48bce...), normalised with the frozen gk_common.normalize_bundle (top-20 candidates in S order, facts[:20]), facts shown as the fact groups that survive the 2,048-token prompt cap of fit_g_prompt. If the Reader's test inference recorded n_truncated = 0 the displayed facts are all normalised facts; otherwise the per-question truncation is recomputed with the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct tokenizer and the frozen renderer (CPU, read-only, on the GPU host). If neither is possible, fact coverage is labelled provisional.

coverage_definitions.F (fact-covered): some gold answer string equals, under official answer matching (multitq_eval: '_' -> ' ', time predictions truncated to len(answers[0]) when that length is 4 or 7), the subject, object or date of at least one displayed provenance fact
coverage_definitions.C (candidate-covered): official hit_at_k(gold, displayed top-20 candidate strings, k = 20) = 1
coverage_definitions.GU_F: Dense-RAG: some gold answer string matches the subject, object or date of at least one of the 20 BGE-retrieved facts as displayed to GU (gu_test.jsonl.gz, sha256 23fef275...; truncation per GU inference stats as above). GU has no candidate list; its 'candidate' axis is not defined.
coverage_definitions.P_own20 (secondary, not displayed to any: gold in the top-20 of the Parser pipeline's own final ranked list (per ranker seed; mean over seeds). The Parser LLM sees only the question; its bundle-coverage cells are a partition by what the structural pipeline displays to the Reader, not by what the Parser saw.

tables: 2x2 F x C per k: n, share of test, Hits@1 (95% bootstrap CI, B = 2000, seed 0, percentile, per cell) of G_k, P_k (seed mean), S_k, RULE_k; paired contrast G_k - P_k per cell (descriptive)
GU_k by GU_F (2 cells) and GU_F crossed with bundle F x C

common-covered subset: per k, questions with F_k and C_k and GU_F; plus the single subset covered at every k (F_1 C_1 F_5 C_5 F_100 C_100 and GU_F); Hits@1 of every arm there and paired contrasts G_k - P_k, G_k - GU_k, P_k - GU_k

successes without displayed coverage: G_k hits with not F and not C (count, share of all G_k hits, rate in the cell); GU_k hits with not GU_F; P_k hits in the bundle not-F-not-C cell (for reference); and G_k hits with C false (answer outside the displayed candidate list)
A2_coverage_conditioned_outcomes.caveat: Presence of a gold string in a displayed fact or candidate does not certify that the displayed material semantically supports the answer (the string can occur in an unrelated fact). Coverage cells are observational partitions, not causal.

selection_discipline: No parameter is tuned; definitions above are fixed before computation. Anything added after this registration is labelled post hoc in the report.
compute: CPU only. Local CPU plus at most one read-only CPU job on the GPU host (copying gu_test.jsonl.gz, the Parser test prediction files and the Reader/GU inference stats, with sha256 checks against the frozen manifests; optional tokenizer-based truncation recount). 0 GPU-h.
deliverables: this plan; A1 tables (CSV + md) and per-question CSV keyed by (probe, quid); A2 tables (CSV + md) and per-question coverage flags CSV keyed by quid; results JSON; short report md; archived copies with a manifest.
